user.title: Behaviour Monitor site
user.description: Name the site and place each sensor in a category. Rooms come from the Home Assistant area of each entity or its device.

whereabouts.title: Where she is
whereabouts.description:
Outside doors: Doors that lead outside. Don't pick fridge, cupboard or internal doors: they would hold back fall alerts.

Bedrooms: Rooms she sleeps in. Stillness here at night is normal.

Sitting appliances: Plugs, like a TV, that mean she is sitting nearby when on.

error.no_entities: Add at least one entity to a category.
error.duplicate_entity: An entity appears in more than one category.
error.door_not_contact: Outside doors must be door and window contacts of this site.
error.appliance_not_plug: Sitting appliances must be power plugs of this site.
